request.state:
L01: The importer runs once an hour and takes whatever it finds in the drop folder.
L02: It reads tab separated files and refuses everything else.
L03: A refused file is moved to the reject folder with a note beside it.
L04: The note names the first line that could not be read.
L05: A file with no header row is refused.
L06: The header row must carry every named column.
L07: Extra columns are ignored and never an error.
L08: An empty file is not an error and is moved aside.
L09: The importer writes a summary line to its own log.
L10: The summary names the counts of rows read, kept, and refused.
L11: Nothing is written to the store until the whole file has been read.

q1.instructions: Which line states the file format the importer accepts?
